headline: BlockLock paper reports reproducible batched LLM inference with fixed request geometry
summary: A 4 November 2026 preprint introduces BlockLock, which fixes the execution geometry of one protected request while retaining shared batched prefill for companion requests. Across five dense models and three GPU types, the authors report bitwise-identical target outputs across companion changes under a fixed deployment contract. The headline performance comparison is narrower: at B=4 and 64 output tokens per request, BlockLock-Rows reduced latency by 53.5–55.0% and increased throughput by 115.2–122.2% versus vLLM Batch-Invariant for Qwen3-8B/14B across eight datasets; reported overhead was 5.4–6.9% versus standard vLLM and 0.5–0.8% versus padded PyTorch. These are author-reported fixed-workload results; no independent reproduction, MoE evaluation or queueing/tail-latency study is established.
